description: This file is a PHP script for the SuiteCRM dashboard page. It manages user preferences, loads dashlets, checks permissions, and renders the dashboard using Smarty templates. It includes logic for cache building, user preference migration, and dynamic dashlet loading.

classes.name: MySugar
classes.description: A class used to check dashlet display permissions and initialize dashlet-related logic.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks whether the dashlet should be displayed for the current user.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML output or content for the dashlet.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header HTML or title for the dashlet.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer HTML for the dashlet.
